subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS provider apiKeys become active SecretRef resolution targets now, and should that wait for the optional missing-key TTS behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: The patch fixes a real credential-resolution gap but intentionally broadens auth-provider target coverage and can change when missing persona TTS SecretRefs fail, which automation cannot treat as a pure code judgment.

options.title: Require Proof Then Land
options.body: After redacted live persona SecretRef TTS proof and a rebase/check refresh, accept this targeted credential-routing expansion as the shared fix.

options.title: Land With Optional-TTS Coordination
options.body: Hold this until the optional missing-key behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 is merged or consciously sequenced with it.

options.title: Narrow Or Pause
options.body: Ask for a narrower variant if maintainers do not want persona-level TTS SecretRefs to participate in active runtime resolution yet.

recommendation.title: Require Proof Then Land
recommendation.body: After redacted live persona SecretRef TTS proof and a rebase/check refresh, accept this targeted credential-routing expansion as the shared fix.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the merged SecretRef coverage framework that owns the registry, collector, and command-target pattern this PR extends.
